narrative.intro: Blue Origin has $1B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Blue Origin has 13 awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $78.6M. Blue Origin obligations are up 863.6% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations rose from $20K in FY21 to $357K in FY22, $15.8M in FY23, $10.6M in FY24, $106M in FY25, and $1B in FY26. National Aeronautics and Space Administration is the largest buyer, obligating $735M. Department of Defense is the second buyer, obligating $287M. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the largest market for Blue Origin, with $744M obligated. Nonscheduled Chartered Freight Air Transportation is the second market, with $278M obligated. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) is a smaller market, with $399K obligated. All figures in this overview are contract obligations unless otherwise noted in award tables, and FY2026 totals are fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: How big is Blue Origin's FY2026 federal business?
body: Blue Origin has $1B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Blue Origin has 13 awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $78.6M.
Blue Origin obligations are up 863.6% year over year, reflecting a large jump from $106M in FY25 to $1B in FY26.

sections.heading: Who buys from Blue Origin and what markets drive the spending?
body: National Aeronautics and Space Administration is the largest buyer, obligating $735M, followed by Department of Defense with $287M.

Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the largest market with $744M obligated, and Nonscheduled Chartered Freight Air Transportation follows with $278M; Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) has $399K obligated.

faq.q: How much does Blue Origin make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Blue Origin has $1B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Blue Origin has 13 awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $78.6M, and obligations are up 863.6% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Blue Origin?
faq.a: National Aeronautics and Space Administration and Department of Defense buy from Blue Origin. National Aeronautics and Space Administration has obligated $735M and Department of Defense has obligated $287M in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does Blue Origin sell to the government?
faq.a: Blue Origin sells guided missile and space vehicle manufacturing and related services to the government. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing has $744M obligated, Nonscheduled Chartered Freight Air Transportation has $278M obligated, and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) has $399K obligated.
